answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a reputation vine that grows only with time: each identity's grading weight rises by a small delta per epoch of honest, verified work, never by deposit alone. A fresh fake account starts its voyage at near-zero influence, so an attacker running a hundred clones must keep each one doing real, independently checked work for many epochs, paying compute and stake for every puppet long before any of them can sway a jury or a payout.
